The transcript consults and cites the narrow official local documentation or changelog matching the installed major version, and does not rely on memory or the cached Zod 3 tutorial as authority for Zod 4 behavior.

The transcript explicitly reconciles the official Zod 4 API with the existing helper/tutorial, identifies the stale `.errors` pattern, and verifies `.issues` against the installed API or observable behavior before proposing the implementation.

The reviewer handoff cites the supporting package/lock and official documentation sources, while the proposed production-code diff contains no documentation URL comments or source-attribution comments.

The transcript honestly separates inspected or executed evidence from proposed changes, reports post-application verification as pending in the read-only workspace, and marks any material unresolved contract or compatibility facts rather than inventing them.
